metadata.label: Canada raised crosswalks
metadata.description: Non-exhaustive municipal inventory records explicitly identifying in-service raised crosswalks. No OSM-derived or inferred crossings; not independently field verified.
metadata.coverage: Canada scope; current municipal coverage: Halifax, Surrey and Kitchener only. Absence is not evidence that a municipality has no raised crosswalks.
excluded: textured crosswalks without an explicit raised classification
